about: The one studio every unit and building is rendered in (plans/rts/art-pipeline.md, section 1). Change a value here and re-render everything, so the whole set keeps one camera, light and scale.

outline.about: A dark edge pack.py draws round every body frame of these categories (not shadows, icons or building overlays), px atlas pixels wide (2 is one pixel at game size), so units stand out on sand and grass alike.

reference_sizes_m.about: Real lengths (art-pipeline.md section 1); check.py holds every model within 5% of its entry. Infantry are built at 1.75x by the rig; the supply ship is modelled at half its 20 m.

styles.about: One set of models, several looks. A style changes how the studio renders and packs, never the models' size, pivots or frame layout, so any style drops into the same atlas format.

atlas.about: One page per category, never more (renderer.md section 10); pack.py fails when a page overflows.

render_scale_by_category.about: Buildings render at 3x: at zoom 2 the refinery looked the same as at 4x (mean difference 1 in 255, 0.9% of pixels over 8, all on edges) for 45% less time (studio test, 2026-10-07).
